Schools in Italy, UK, and Ireland receive bomb threats

Over 6,000 schools across Italy received bomb threats via email, prompting evacuations in some areas. Approximately 300 schools in Italy were evacuated. Similar threats were also reported in schools in the UK and Ireland. Authorities in Italy are investigating the matter, and in Ireland, the threats were deemed 'not credible' and responded to as hoax emails. The threats were reportedly sent from a group identifying itself as 'Misoginistan'.
